newsitem.title: BOSNIA: Bosnia bus robbed at gunpoint in Serb area.
newsitem.headline: Bosnia bus robbed at gunpoint in Serb area.

text.p: Gunmen held up a bus in Bosnian Serb territory on Friday, robbing and intimidating its passengers, state radio said on Saturday.
The Sarajevo-based bus with 10 passengers on board was on the road from Sarajevo to the isolated Moslem enclave of Gorazde in eastern Bosnia when it was attacked.
The gang fired four bullets and detonated a hand grenade inside the bus but there were no casualties, a statement by the Moslem-Croat federation interior ministry said.
The road is patrolled by NATO-led peacekeeping troops but federation traffic has frequently been harassed by hostile Serbs.
Under Bosnia's peace accord, an alternative road from Sarajevo was constructed to Gorazde through federation territory but it has not been metalled, making travel difficult.
